Grow. function toggleSidebar() { const sidebar = document.getElementById('crmSidebar'); const overlay = document.getElementById('crmSidebarOverlay'); sidebar.classList.toggle('open'); overlay.classList.toggle('active'); document.body.classList.toggle('sidebar-open', sidebar.classList.contains('open')); } function toggleSubmenu(id) { const item = document.getElementById(id); if (item) { item.classList.toggle('open'); } } function toggleDropdown(dropdownId) { const dropdown = document.getElementById(dropdownId); const allDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.crm-dropdown-menu'); allDropdowns.forEach(d => { if (d.id !== dropdownId) d.classList.remove('open'); }); if (dropdown) { dropdown.classList.toggle('open'); } } const selectedCompanies = new Set(['Ultrawin Technolgies']); function toggleCompanySelection(name, elem) { const checkbox = elem.querySelector('.crm-company-checkbox'); const checkIcon = elem.querySelector('.crm-company-checkbox i'); if (selectedCompanies.has(name)) { // Prevent unselecting if it's the only one selected if (selectedCompanies.size > 1) { selectedCompanies.delete(name); elem.classList.remove('selected'); if (checkbox) checkbox.classList.remove('selected'); if (checkIcon) checkIcon.style.display = 'none'; } } else { selectedCompanies.add(name); elem.classList.add('selected'); if (checkbox) checkbox.classList.add('selected'); if (checkIcon) checkIcon.style.display = 'block'; } // Update topbar label and footer dynamically const count = selectedCompanies.size; const labelElem = document.getElementById('currentCompanyName'); const badgeElem = document.getElementById('selectedCountBadge'); const footerElem = document.getElementById('crmDashboardFooter'); if (count === 1) { const singleName = Array.from(selectedCompanies)[0]; labelElem.innerText = singleName; if (footerElem) footerElem.innerHTML = `${singleName} CRM · Connect. Manage. Grow.`; } else { labelElem.innerText = count + ' Companies'; if (footerElem) footerElem.innerHTML = `Ultrawin Technolgies CRM · Connect. Manage. Grow.`; } if (badgeElem) { badgeElem.innerText = count + ' Selected'; } } function markAllRead() { document.querySelectorAll('.crm-notif-item').forEach(item => { item.classList.remove('unread'); }); const dot = document.getElementById('crmNotifDot'); if (dot) dot.style.display = 'none'; const badge = document.querySelector('.crm-notif-head span'); if (badge) badge.innerText = '0 Unread'; } // Close dropdowns when clicking outside document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (!e.target.closest('.crm-dropdown-container')) { document.querySelectorAll('.crm-dropdown-menu').forEach(d => d.classList.remove('open')); } });
